title: Recording, mixing: Walking On Thin Ice by Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

John Lennon and Yoko Ono continued recording Ono’s song ‘Walking On Thin Ice’ on 4 December 1980.

The song had been started on 14 August, but was left until 3 December while the couple focused on the Double Fantasy album.

This was Lennon’s final recording session, although he took part in a mixing session on 8 December. He added guitars and keyboards, Ono recorded more vocals, and co-producer Jack Douglas overdubbed percussion.

After the recording was complete, the song was mixed for the first time. The session ended at 8am the following morning.
